Before we begin

A few useful answers.

Can I enquire about a new project or a non-food business?

Yes. Enquiries may cover vendors, operational output, commercial planning and digital channels across trading, retail, food and other product-based businesses. Every request is assessed against relevant experience and available capacity before acceptance.

What will I receive from the consultation?

Depending on the agreed scope, deliverables may include a diagnostic summary, vendor comparison, feasibility workbook, sales plan, digital roadmap or KPI tracker. Your proposal will list exactly what is included.

Is an onsite visit included?

Onsite visits can be arranged subject to location and availability. The written quotation will state whether a visit and associated travel are included.

Does digital advisory include website development or advertising?

Digital advisory covers requirements, customer journeys, channel priorities and performance measures. Website builds, advertising management, technical integrations and specialist implementation are separately scoped; they are not automatically included.

Does submitting an enquiry confirm a booking?

An enquiry starts the discussion. Work begins only after the scope, fee, schedule and terms are agreed in writing. Recommendations depend on the information reviewed; financial results are not guaranteed.
